questions: What does Zaid hang on the string?
Why will the ring not zip at the start?
Who dips the end so the ring can zip?

pronunciation_notes.title: Watch Out - Two Letters, One Sound
pronunciation_notes.body: 'n' and 'g' team up to make ONE sound: /ng/. Say it once at the end of the word - 'ri-ng', not 'ri-n-g'. In this story you'll hear it in 'ring', 'string' and 'zing'.
